text: When an AI agent starts over, should your research have to start over too?
We built Second Shift so that every new decision can begin with evidence from the work already done.
Here, it is running experiments on recorded brain signals, with MongoDB Atlas holding the campaign's memory.
Now watch what happens when I stop the worker in the middle of an experiment.
The worker disappears, but its completed results remain. When we restart it, those results are reused, and the interrupted experiment runs again.
Now we give it a different challenge: work with just nine electrodes instead of sixty-four.
It rechecks its earlier results, rebuilds its context, and continues under the new constraint.
That is Second Shift: an agent that can start fresh while its research keeps moving forward.
